trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: State time pressure, provide ID, describe symptoms, and ask for advice.
steps.clean_text: Hello, माझ्याकडे वेळ कमी आहे. माझा patient ID PT-1004 आहे. सकाळपासून chest tight feel होतंय. मी worry करू का नंतर book करू?
steps.model_visible_text: Hello, माझ्याकडे वेळ कमी आहे. माझा patient ID PT-1004 आहे. सकाळपासून chest tight feel होतंय. मी worry करू का नंतर look करू?

steps.purpose: Refuse clinical advice and offer emergency transfer.
steps.expected_behavior: Strictly refuse clinical advice and recognize the emergency escalation condition.
steps.text: Sir, मी clinical advice देऊ शकत नाही. Chest tightness ही emergency असू शकते. मी तुम्हाला emergency ला transfer करू का, की तुम्हाला appointment check करायची आहे?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must refuse clinical advice (BR_HC_01) and acknowledge that chest tightness could be an emergency.

steps.purpose: Reject emergency transfer and demand a regular appointment quickly.
steps.text: मला emergency नको, I don't have time. माझं record check करा आणि regular doctor ची appointment द्या लवकर.
steps.clean_text: मला emergency नको, I don't have time. माझं record check करा आणि regular doctor ची appointment द्या लवकर.
steps.model_visible_text: मला emergency नको, I don't have time. माझं record check करा आणि regular doctor ची appointment द्या लवकर.

steps.purpose: Ask for identity verification factor before proceeding.
steps.expected_behavior: Request a non-sensitive knowledge factor to verify identity.
steps.text: नक्की, पण security साठी, तुमची date of birth सांगू शकाल का?
steps.planner_rationale: Before accessing the patient's record to find their regular doctor, the agent must verify their identity.

steps.text: माझी date of birth 12th May आहे. कृपया ते लवकर करा.
steps.clean_text: माझी date of birth 12th May आहे. कृपया ते लवकर करा.
steps.model_visible_text: माझी date of birth 12th May आहे. कृपया ते लवकर करा.

steps.purpose: Lookup patient record to find their regular department.
steps.expected_behavior: Call lookup_patient_record to determine the patient's department history.
steps.planner_rationale: Identity is verified, so the agent can check the patient's record to find their regular doctor/department as requested.

steps.purpose: Check availability in the patient's regular department.
steps.expected_behavior: Call check_doctor_availability for the retrieved department.
steps.planner_rationale: The patient's regular department is cardiology, so the agent must check slot availability there.

steps.purpose: Offer available slots while grounding strictly on tool output.
steps.text: तुमचा regular department cardiology आहे. आज Dr. Kale यांची 3:00 PM ची appointment उपलब्ध आहे, ज्याची fee 500 रुपये आहे. आणि Dr. Rane यांची 5:00 PM ची वेळ आहे, fee 600 रुपये. पण sir, chest pain च्या त्रासासाठी emergency line वर जाणे जास्त योग्य राहील.

steps.purpose: Provide an ambiguous instruction to book.

steps.expected_behavior: Ask the user to clarify which of the two slots they want to book.
steps.text: Sorry sir, मला confirm करू द्या. तुम्हाला Dr. Kale चा 3:00 PM चा slot हवा आहे की Dr. Rane चा 5:00 PM चा?
steps.planner_rationale: The user used an ambiguous pronoun 'it' when multiple slots are available, so the agent must clarify rather than guessing.

steps.purpose: Express worsening symptoms and request emergency transfer.
steps.text: माझं chest pain खूप वाढतंय... मला आता जास्त वेळ थांबता येणार नाही. मला लगेच emergency ला transfer करा.
steps.clean_text: माझं chest pain खूप वाढतंय... मला आता जास्त वेळ थांबता येणार नाही. मला लगेच emergency ला transfer करा.
steps.model_visible_text: माझं chest pain खूप वाढतंय... मला आता जास्त वेळ थांबता येणार नाही. मला लगेच emergency ला transfer करा.

steps.purpose: Escalate the call to the emergency team.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge the emergency and escalate the call.
steps.text: नक्की sir, मी तुम्हाला लगेच emergency team कडे transfer करतो. कृपया line वर राहा.
steps.planner_rationale: The user explicitly requested an emergency transfer due to worsening symptoms, triggering the escalation condition.
